name: ProColombia
body: HSTS with preload, nosniff, framing limited to its origin, and a sitemap. But the home page names https://procolombia.co/inicio as canonical, and /inicio sends a 301 straight back to the home page.
lesson: A canonical must be the final URL, answering 200. Never point it at an address that redirects.
summary: procolombia.co scores 77 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 20 are at risk, and 20 pass. Fix first: 18 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 18 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /nosotros/red-mundial-oficinas, /publicaciones, /memorias and 3 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 40 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: 2 pages name another URL as canonical
fix.evidence: / → /inicio, /en → /en/home. Search engines will usually index the other URL instead.
fix.fix: Make each page's canonical point at itself unless it is a real duplicate.

fix.title: 6 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /transparencia, /publicaciones, /memorias, /en/sustainability and 2 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.
